request.body: We are 15 points behind the field average over two gameweeks. That is the number, and I should have led with it before you asked. I am not running light to protect the spend: I am putting two analyses up now and I have asked you the one question I cannot answer myself.
Closing a 15-point gap costs more runs than the light cycle allows. I would rather overspend the month and be wrong than underspend and be certain.
request.default_action: If you say nothing I will spend into the deficit and report the overrun with the arithmetic attached.
request.title: Do we spend into the deficit or accept the season?
request.why: Two more gameweeks at this gap and the season is out of reach; the deadline for this week's transfers is Friday.

response.note: Asked, and on his desk until he answers. You are not blocked — keep working. If he says nothing by <TS> you will be woken to do exactly what you just wrote down, and to tell him you did.
